item.research_question: How can a comprehensive, updated database of mechanical properties and observed phases for multi-principal element alloys (MPEAs) be compiled to aid in identifying design space gaps and training machine learning models?
item.material_system: 630 multi-principal element alloys (MPEAs), including complex concentrated alloys (CCAs) with 3 or more principal elements, covering single-phase BCC, single-phase FCC, and multiphase/other microstructures.
item.processing_route: Data extraction from 265 articles (including 136 new articles published in 2019) using keyword search for 'high entropy alloy' on Web of Science; data digitized from plots using webplotdigitizer and combined with previous reviews from 2018.
item.test_conditions: Mechanical testing performed under tension (T) or compression (C) at various temperatures; properties extracted include yield strength, ultimate tensile/compression strength, elongation, hardness, and Young's modulus.
key_findings: The database contains 1545 records from 265 articles, representing a > 100% improvement in available data compared to 2018 reviews.
The study extracted 334 unique MPEA compositions (931 composition-property combinations) in addition to the 296 unique compositions from previous reviews.
Data fields include normalized alloy composition, experimentally observed phases, processing method, grain size, density, and interstitial contents (O, N, C).
Extreme values in property distributions were identified using box plots and investigated for removal or correction.
The database is hosted on Citrination and includes Physical Information File (PIF) records for machine learning applications.
Visualizations of yield strength vs. elongation and temperature dependence of yield strength were generated to guide future research.
item.mechanism: The authors explain that the large compositional design space of MPEAs (e.g., 143,000 potential 5-component systems) makes experimental examination of each system prohibitively expensive, necessitating data-driven methods and accurate data accounting to accelerate exploration.
item.limitations: Not all properties in the database are reported for every record; specifically, grain size and interstitial contents are missing from many articles despite their importance for refractory MPEAs.
item.future_work: Researchers are encouraged to contribute new data to the database via a template on GitHub and upload to Citrination to ensure routine updating and improved predictive capabilities for machine learning models.
quotes: The database contains 1545 records from 265 articles.
On a per record basis, this database presents a > 100% improvement in the amount of available data when compared to the data presented in the 2018 reviews.
Often, not all properties in the database are reported for every record.
